assertion_analysis.regression: Restore the per-document walk in _indexed_data (make reuse_documents always False); the 200-document warm count climbs to 202 while the 20-document count stays at 22, so `small[0] == large[0]` fails. Demonstrated by negative-control.log.

Remove the _bump_generation call from write_run_file / append_run / _write_state; `before` and `after` become equal, so `after != before` fails, and the read-back assertions also fall back to the previous document value.

assertion_analysis.self_referential_assertions: line 158 (`assert after is not None and after != before`) is not independent of the restore bump it claims to guard: `before` is read at line 150, then line 153's write_run_file already advances the generation, so removing _bump_generation from _restore_run_files leaves both the inequality and the read-back at line 161 true.

assertion_analysis.regression: Make the read reuse stamps despite an absent generation; the in-place edited document's gate stays 'passed' and the >=20 stat assertion also fails.
Drop the runs-directory identity from reuse_documents; a document added without a generation bump is missing from the warm read.

findings.text: non-blocking: the restore-bump assertion cannot fail if the `_bump_generation` call at the end of `_restore_run_files` (reckon/ledger.py:2244) is removed, because line 153's `write_run_file` already advanced the generation past the `before` value read at line 150; re-read the generation immediately before `_restore_run_files` so the guard is independent of the intervening write.

non-blocking: `_split_project_runs` bumps the generation but no test drives that write path, so the done_when's 'a write through each ledger write path bumps the generation, and the next read sees the new row' is asserted for four of the five ledger write paths; tests/test_split_existing_runs.py never reads back through ledger.load after a split.

non-blocking: the generation is read and written in the directory `_run_index_path` resolves for the calling process, so a ledger write made by a process whose `_index_directory()` falls back to the user cache (reckon/ledger.py:1237-1242) bumps a different file than a reader using the configured cache directory; that reader's index keeps a matching generation and reuses stale stamps for a modified document, since the runs-directory identity only moves on addition or removal.

non-blocking: `ledger_generation_path`, `ledger_generation` and `_bump_generation` duplicate the write-generation cache-key capability the repository already owns at reckon/_store.py:1806 (`write_generation_path`, `read_write_generation`, `advance_write_generation`, consumed at reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py:245 and reckon/crew/obligations.py:1646) instead of extending it; a separate per-ledger-path file may be justified because the owner's file lives under the configuration home that the worker fence mounts read-only, but the diff states neither the comparison nor that reason.

non-blocking: the done_when requires 'ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths', but the run's test_logs and evidence_inputs record no ruff log; the only evidence is the session stream ('All checks passed! 2 files already formatted'), which a reader of the run directory cannot open, so the clause is claimed rather than recorded.

justifications.durability: the warm stat-count test reddens under the declared negative control (negative-control.log: assert 202 < 10), but tests/test_a_ledger_read_does_not_walk_every_run.py:158 cannot fail if the restore bump at reckon/ledger.py:2244 is removed, and reckon/ledger.py:3316 has no driving test.
justifications.evidence: gate.log (60 passed, EXIT=0), negative-control.log (3 failed, EXIT=1, 200-run count 202), arm-base.log and arm-head.log (71 and 70 failures, empty head-only delta) all carry their revision and literal command, but no ruff result is recorded under the run directory and the split write path is untested.
justifications.fit: the added ledger_generation_path, ledger_generation and _bump_generation names follow the module's existing private-helper and sqlite-metadata idiom (reckon/ledger.py:1168-1183) and carry no plan, stage or ticket identifiers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1697 keys the run index on a write generation and a run-directory identity, and reproduction.log records 2 stat calls at both 20 and 200 run documents against 21 and 201 at the base revision.
justifications.reuse: reckon/_store.py:1806 already owns a write-generation file used as a cache key (write_generation_path/read_write_generation/advance_write_generation, read at reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py:245 and reckon/crew/obligations.py:1646); reckon/ledger.py:1190 adds a second such mechanism rather than extending that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in `git diff --stat acfbdab8c1bb..8ec4cd228f17` is inside the six write paths on the run's live node record (reckon/crew/live pointer), the last two of which the coordinator widened from the four in prompt.txt.
